summary: This class discusses the custom of Hinukh HaBayit when acquiring or constructing a new home. It mentions sources in Debarim, midrashim, and books by Hakhamim such as the Chida, Rabbi Chaim Palachi, the Ben Ish Chai, and Hakham Yitzchak Alfiya. It also explains the components of the meal and dedication, including Torah, charity, and thanking Hashem.
